The parent is probably re-rendering, which causes children to re-render too. Three things to check:

**Is the parent re-rendering?** Open your DevTools Profiler and record what's happening. You'll see which components actually re-render, not just which ones are called.

**Are you passing new objects or functions each render?** This is sneaky. Code like `onClick={() => doThing()}` or `style={{color: 'red'}}` creates a brand new object every render, so your child sees different props even if the values look the same. Move those outside the render, or use `useCallback` and `useMemo`.

**Is the child checking props correctly?** By default React doesn't skip re-renders even with the same props. Wrap it in `React.memo()` if you want React to skip the child render when props haven't changed.

If you share your code I can spot which one it is.
